invariants.rationale: Method requires a non-null instant time to operate meaningfully; passing null could indicate misuse.
The method expects a list of partitions to delete; null input may not be intended and could result in exceptions elsewhere.
If partitions is not empty, its size is non-negative; reflects correct List semantics.
Typically, an instant time should be a non-empty string; helps prevent downstream errors.
List of partitions should not contain null elements, as null partition types would be invalid for this operation.
